topic: Immediate field input and reliable cooldown taps
currentUserGoal: Remove the sluggish delay between pressing the field and receiving touch feedback, and stop valid off-cooldown clicks from being silently dropped.
workCompleted: Moved mouse and pen field touches from pointer release to pointer press so model registration, visual feedback, and grass-touch audio begin in the same interaction.
Kept large-field touchscreen panning usable while making the one-tile touchscreen field react immediately.
Replaced the old per-event 3 px drag test with total-displacement gesture tracking and separate 8 px mouse and 14 px touch thresholds.
Made cooldown checks use the current input timestamp instead of the previous render frame timestamp.
Added redesign harness counters for pointer downs, real drags, touch attempts, accepted touches, blocked touches, and input latency.
Kept the pointer-move path allocation-free so the gesture fix does not add drag-time garbage collection pressure.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 143 Vitest tests across 19 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Desktop 1280x720 browser verification accepted a touch while the mouse button was still held, with 0.1 ms maximum measured input latency.
Desktop browser instrumentation scheduled grass-touch audio approximately 2.5 ms after pointer press.
A 6 px desktop pointer wobble remained a valid tap with zero false drags.
Phone 390x844 browser verification accepted the one-tile touch before release, accepted a small multi-tile touch wobble, and classified a deliberate swipe as one pan.
No browser warnings, console errors, or page errors were observed in the final desktop or phone passes.

release.status: Verified local input checkpoint; not merged into master or promoted to production.

currentGitStatus: The branch already contains one local collapse-presentation commit that is ahead of origin.
This field-input slice is ready for a local checkpoint commit on codex/ecosystem-factory-prototype.
docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains an unrelated untracked file and must stay untouched unless the user explicitly requests it.
The local Vite server remains available at http://127.0.0.1:5173.
knownIssues: On multi-tile touchscreen fields, touch actions intentionally commit on release so a swipe can pan without firing an accidental touch; the measured synthetic tap latency was still below 35 ms.
Mouse and pen pans begin with one beneficial field touch because immediate click feedback is prioritized over suppressing the first touch of a drag.
The current input metrics are cumulative for the scene lifetime and are intended for playtest diagnosis rather than player-facing telemetry.
nextRecommendedSteps: Hands-on test repeated rank-zero taps around the 380 ms recovery boundary with normal audio volume.
Decide later whether large-field touch devices should gain a dedicated pan mode if release-time touch confirmation ever feels too soft.
Continue the surviving-phase gameplay slice after input responsiveness is approved.
doNotRevert: Do not move desktop field touches back to pointer release.
Do not restore the old per-pointermove 3 px Manhattan drag threshold.
Keep field gesture tracking allocation-free on pointermove.
Keep cooldown timing and cooldown presentation on the same performance-time basis.
Do not use the legacy 1,200-tile harness as evidence for ecosystemPrototype performance.
